name: 20838-prefillheavy-mambacodestral7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Mamba2ForCausalLM (model_type `mamba2`), 64 mamba2 layers and no attention layer, bf16, ~7.29e9 params; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup the first 10%, bounded at 512 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix reuse: 2048 prompt tokens in and 16 output tokens out, both fixed (min = max), `ignore_eos: true`, sampling left at vLLM's defaults. Independent random token ids per request, so nothing is shared between two requests.
purpose: A code-completion helper on one GPU, serving eight concurrent developers long 2048-token files with brief completions.
launch:
model: mistralai/Mamba-Codestral-7B-v0.1
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# Required, not a choice: config.json carries none of the keys vLLM derives a context window
# from, so it falls through to default_max_len = 2048 and rejects a 2048-in / 16-out request.
max-model-len: 4096

# Required at this vLLM: the V1 model runner raises NotImplementedError at startup for a mamba
# layer with cuda graphs on, and again for prefix caching, which V1 turns on by default.
enforce-eager: true
enable-prefix-caching: false

max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 64
